title: Ancient DNA Links Ice Age Europeans Across the Continent
paragraphs: Scientists have studied very old human DNA from Europe. It comes from the Ice Age, a cold time long ago. A team of 37 researchers worked on the study.
One woman lived about 30,000 years ago in Isturitz Cave, in France. Most of her family came from western Europe. But she also had family from central and eastern Europe.

This means that people from the east and the west met and had children together. Before this, many scientists thought they lived apart. The team also found DNA in the soil of a cave in Spain, even though there were no human bones there.
